Fellow American,

**_I would be honored if you could spare just one minute to read this heartfelt memo in its entirety. I guarantee it will be well worth your time._ **

**My parents taught me that when you're in trouble, the best thing to do is to tell the truth.**

So here's the unfiltered truth of serving in New York City:

* I'm the last NYC Republican in Congress
* My fundraising numbers are drastically declining
* My district is under attack by radical protests and antisemitism
* More migrants than ever are moving to NYC and can legally squat in our homes

**My friend, I said I'd give you the unfiltered truth.**

**_I'm scared. I'm sad. I'm run down._** But I refuse to give up the hope that led me to serve you in our government in the first place.

I've been wracking my brain for ways to make concrete change in a country where it seems as though one step forward triggers twelve steps back.

| [ **BE A PART OF THE SOLUTION** ](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=cdbdb312748146eb9df133a0da0cbe0b&_e=dBdxvhYkRRWe4esJWmXDNmewIJCOExSE7jzfzI5_Px-dqQTLhQIbiTz3s5i24PRdZJT6M9I_30ntsmMFQuAV1LFegkCvC13QeEubsK4lx5PC7320OIhmmtqprZoIHTQqocs4K5bD4ljYEecCciG0-MHU4KMF0rxUfiQMH4E2ifQxIPq--QiMFItcv965pCIQ7OnkmZXHbRJh0BDrQxpcRrS1Hhh5ZJ_fFM4YCYjvClTqpAWo5GSfMbU5c6mo9dKY0c1yI7RMISBoj3tusxDHgWHSTPq0RL1_tH3J4WuerDZU-bCkpWGhvb6pH1vfEZA9BIkdjLTUSihZFMUrTRVFGOISP5WQNBaSBzO8TjnSkSH6mphVxlyETgJGSQpXEfBAaMNyOWH-JTc9rYksZSmZuiqqt-AHKvhCVDcFbMLAltQ%3D)

**So please allow me to share my vision:**

* I want open communication with _**ALL Americans**_ , on both sides of the aisle, to encourage fruitful policy change and rational laws in this nation. You have my email- don't be afraid to say hi.
* I wish to inform _**ALL Americans**_ of the truth of the mayhem in our cities and the radical ideas that are pushed upon our youth against their will.
* I hope to inspire a spirit of hope within _**ALL Americans**_ to stand up and make a change in our country.

**We have power in numbers. If you can't relate to my unfiltered truth, I thank you for your attention. You can close this email now.**

**If my truth has inspired you to fight for your nation in any way you can, keep reading.**

Joe Biden is relying on a broken system and his own corruption to hold onto the White House for another four years. Life will get worse if he succeeds. It truly is only downhill from here- he's already promised higher taxes and unchecked immigration.

## We're Just Getting Started!

**___________________________________________________________________________**
Friend,

Thank you for every ounce you gave to Gabe's campaign during the primary. Your commitment helped us enjoy a decisive Primary Election victory.

As we move into the next phase – the face-off with vulnerable Democrat incumbent Yadira Caraveo – we need your help executing a grassroots program that can rival anything Colorado has seen. But we can't do it without your help!

I know it's a commitment, and I know you can't be with us every week, but even an hour or two over the course of the campaign will make a valuable impact on reaching voters with Gabe's message. Find information below on how you can get involved this week.
**___________________________________________________________________________**
****
**_Phone Bank_**
******
When:** Wednesday, July 3rd, 5:30 – 7:30pm
**
Where:** Satire Brewing Company 12136 Grant Cir, Thornton, CO

Voter lists, scripts and talking points will be provided, as well as light refreshments.

**___________________________________________________________________________**

**_Door Canvassing_**
Tomorrow, Saturday June 29th at 9:00am
*Training will begin at 8:30am (_Trying to beat the heat _)**

_South Location_**
Starbucks
__13671 Colorado Blvd. _**North Location:**_
2308 W. 17th St. Greeley, CO 80634

* Training, literature and talking points provided.

* If this is your first time to knock doors, please ensure you have been set up on the Walk App (Numinar). For help getting onboarded, please contact Jessica at [Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com](mailto:Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com) or [(720) 691-0565](tel:\(720\) 691-0565).
**___________________________________________________________________________**_

**_Greeley Parade_**

_ Join Gabe and the campaign team as we participate in the Greeley Stampede Independence Day Parade!

Time: 8:30am

Location: Park and Meetup at the UNC Commons
1051 22nd St, Greeley, CO 80639
__
Please[Click Here](https://wayrap.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjYwMjExMCxcImxcIjoxMjU0Mjk4NDkxNjk4NTYyNDgsXCJyXCI6MTI1NDI5ODUwOTgwNzQ3MTc2fSIsInMiOiJkYWVkOGJhYzczZThmYmZlIn0) to sign up for the parade.
_**___________________________________________________________________________**
_
Thanks again for all your hard work. Please let us know if you have any questions regarding these events by contacting Tyler Moore at 405.314.3271.
_
_ All the best,

Tyler Moore
Campaign Manager
www.ElectGabeEvans.com

We set an ambitious End of Quarter goal of raising $6,000 by tonight at midnight so we could be prepared for November, but we’re only at $5,206 – meaning we’re short by $794 with just a few hours until the deadline. With Trump on the ballot, you know how difficult it’s going to be to elect strong Democrats in November. Trump gets his voters out to the polls to vote for him and other Republicans, and the only way to combat him is to work twice as hard to turn out Democrats. While that may sound easy, it means more money spent on ads, organizers, and literature about our candidates – and that’s why it’s so critical that we hit our End of Quarter goal. If we miss it, we’ll be behind the 8-ball heading into the most important few months of the year for our County Parties. name: Alsobrooks HQ
subject: It's Your Weekly Team Alsobrooks Newsletter!
body:
Greetings #Team Alsobrooks,

Thank you to all our supporters who showed up and showed out! Our
people-powered movement is growing more and more everyday.

In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening on the campaign trail
and beyond:

The two year anniversary of Dobbs is a reminder that we must be vigilant
in fighting for and protecting our freedoms and never take our liberties
for granted. We joined Vice President Kamala Harris to discuss how we can
protect reproductive rights and stand against Donald Trump and the
Republican party’s attempt to strip away democracy.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1026&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1036&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

We are proud to announce that the Maryland State Education Association has
endorsed our campaign for Senate. As County Executive, Angela broke ground
on 10 new schools in Prince George’s. As Senator, she will continue the
fight to increase Title I funding for public education and support our
students and teachers. No child’s zip code should determine the quality of
their education.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1037&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Thank you former Councilwoman Megan Outten for hosting and to former State
Senator James Mathias and everyone else who joined us for an awesome meet
and greet in Ocean City! It was so great chatting with folks about how we
are going to protect reproductive rights, fight gun violence, and ensure
Democrats have the key 51st vote in the Senate. Let’s keep Maryland blue
together!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1038&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Maryland Democrats were fired up at the MD Dems gala! Our future is at
stake this election, and it is the honor of a lifetime to be your nominee
for Senate. We are taking this fight and our momentum all the way to the
polls this November. Together, we will win.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1039&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

We had the pleasure of marching in the Scotland Juneteenth Festival at the
Cabin John Regional Park, a place where enslaved Americans were once
forced to work. The Scotland community was one of the earliest African
American settlements in Montgomery County and represents the resilience of
the early families who called this neighborhood home. Thank you to
everyone who joined us, including Montgomery County Executive Marc Elrich,
and marched alongside our team. We will never stop fighting until we
achieve true equality for all!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1040&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1041&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Proud to join so many familiar faces at Bowie’s Juneteenth weekend
celebration. Juneteenth is a chance to celebrate the progress we’ve made
and is also a reminder of the substantial work that needs to be done for
the community.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1042&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1043&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Thank you to Senator Ben Cardin for joining us for a discussion with
Jewish community leaders in Pikesville and a tour of the Pikesville
Armory.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1027&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1028&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Thank you to Prince George’s County Muslim Council for letting us join
their Eid al-Adha celebration. Great to see friends, Councilman Calvin
Hawkins and Circuit Court Clerk Mahasin El Amin!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1029&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Another great Sunday service in the books! Thank you to Pastor Matthew L.
Watley for the invitation to join the Kingdom Fellowship AME Church
congregation. Looking forward to coming back again soon!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1030&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

The 6th annual Kappa Takeover was a huge success! Thank you to Terence
Matthews for the invitation, and to Grand Polemarch Jimmy McMikle, Eastern
Province Polemarch Richard Mattox, and all of the leadership, for allowing
us to join you for such a worthy cause. We are grateful for the work of
Kappa Alpha Psi in creating scholarships and community service programs
for young people around our nation.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1031&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1032&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

It was so great joining Ray Benton to kick off the JTCC Children’s tennis
tournament in College Park! Thanks to everyone in the community who came
together to make this tournament a success.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1033&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

Thank you to the folks at IBEW Local 26 for your endorsement and for a
great roundtable discussion about how we can do more to support the over
820,000 members and retirees who do so much to support our economy along
with a tour of your facilities.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1034&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

In the News

ENDORSEMENT ANNOUNCEMENT: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27852?t=1001&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]United Food and Commercial Workers Local 400

ENDORSEMENT ANNOUNCEMENT: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27853?t=1002&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]United Food and Commercial Workers 1994
MCGEO

ENDORSEMENT ANNOUNCEMENT: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27854?t=1003&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]International Association of Ironworkers –
Local 568 and Local 5

The Associated Press: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27855?t=1004&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Trump endorses former Maryland governor Larry
Hogan’s Senate bid

WHUR: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27856?t=1005&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Alsobrooks Presents Prince George’s State of the Economy
“The Prince George's County economic outlook is the focus today as Prince
George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks delivered her State of the
Economy for the County. Alsobrooks focused on the Metro Blue Line, health
care, small businesses and the coming of the FBI headquarters to Greenbelt
as areas of success.”

MSNBC: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27857?t=1006&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]It’s about ‘the future’: Senate nominee Alsobrooks talks Dems’
battle for Senate majority
“Democratic Nominee for Senate Angela Alsobrooks joins The Weekend to
discuss Democrats' fight to retain their Senate majority.”

AFRO American Newspapers: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27859?t=1007&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Vice President Kamala Harris speaks two
years after Roe v. Wade is overturned
“Today is more than just an anniversary. It's proof that we should never
take for granted our liberties,' said Democratic nominee for U.S Senate
and Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks at the gathering.
'It's the confirmation that we must be vigilant and fighting for and
protecting, with everything we have, our rights.”

MSNBC: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27860?t=1008&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maryland wants to ruin Mitch
McConnell’s plan
“On the anniversary of the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision overturning Roe
vs. Wade, Maryland's Democratic Nominee for Senate Angela Alsobrooks joins
MSNBC's Lawrence O'Donnell to discuss why her race is critical to
Democrats retaining control of the Senate and codifying abortion rights.”

GET INVOLVED

Join us for our first General Election Weekend of Action on June 29th and
30th! We need to start putting the heat in the streets and finding new
supports and volunteers. Join us at an event near you!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/17082?t=1009&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27452?t=1010&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Knock Doors in Anne Arundel

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27453?t=1011&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Knock Doors in Baltimore City

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27454?t=1012&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Knock Doors in Baltimore County

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/17086?t=1013&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Knock Doors in Montgomery

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27455?t=1014&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Knock Doors in Prince George’s

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27456?t=1015&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Host Your Own Canvass Launch

[ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12166?t=1016&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Find Other Events Near You

Join us for a 4th of July parade! We’ll be marching all across Maryland
next week. Find an event near you at [ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12166?t=1017&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]angelaalsobrooks.com/events.

Sign up to volunteer to join our organizing efforts for the General
Election and an organizer will reach out soon! [ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9785?t=1018&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Sign up to volunteer
here.

In the meantime, we have to talk to Lottie, Dottie, and everybody!
Download our Alsobrooks App and get the latest campaign updates straight
to your phone so you can text your friends. We won this primary by
mobilizing thousands of supporters to talk to thousands of their friends.
We are going to have to do it again and on an even bigger scale. Download
the app to get started at [ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12441?t=1019&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]angelaalsobrooks.com/app.

We are launching our Alsobrooks Summer Fellowship! Are you a high school
or college student looking to learn about campaigns? Do you know some
young people looking to get involved with the campaign? Then have them
join our fellowship program! Fellows are volunteers who commit 5 to 10
hours per week to talk to voters, help at events, and contribute to
special projects. Apply at [ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9723?t=1020&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]angelaalsobrooks.com/fellowship.

Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by
grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do
better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all
of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November.

[ https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=1021&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Volunteer

[ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12166?t=1022&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Find Events Near You

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27290?t=1035&amount=25&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Donate

SOCIALS

While we'll keep sending emails to keep you updated, the best way to keep
up with Angela is on our social media channels. Follow us on Twitter,
Facebook, and Instagram to follow along with us on the campaign trail!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8814?t=1023&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Facebook

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8815?t=1024&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Twitter

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8816?t=1025&akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK ]Instagram

Sincerely,

Team Alsobrooks

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1934%2E52803%2EDyK-nK

Right now, there’s an all hands on deck effort in Florida to get out the vote and get this amendment passed. That takes funding, which is why we’re coming to you. Will you split a donation of $25 or any amount with Florida Women’s Freedom Coalition and The Real Texas PAC to help restore abortion access in the south? Hi Peter, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I’m personally writing this email.
When I was in public school in Brooklyn, New York, I learned that Pennsylvania was the Keystone State and that a keystone is the central, wedge-shaped stone in an arch without which the arch would collapse.
[**Bob Casey is a keystone in the U.S. Senate. Will you join me in supporting his re-election?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240628-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20240628-5&refcode2=3417_552475_VitM5_&akid=3417%2E552475%2EVitM5_)
As a member of our narrow Democratic Senate majority, Bob serves on four committees to protect Pennsylvanians’ paychecks, pensions, Social Security, and our very democracy. And he fights every day to lift working families.
Bob voted FOR the American Rescue Plan Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, the CHIPS and Science Act, and the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. Last year, he worked with President Biden and Governor Shapiro to accelerate the restoration of I-95—and he credits and supports the workers who got it done in record time!
[**Will you join me in donating $5 or whatever you can afford right now to re-elect Bob Casey? If you’re ready to click now, thank you so much, and enjoy the rest of your day.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240628-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20240628-5&refcode2=3417_552475_VitM5_&akid=3417%2E552475%2EVitM5_)
Bob lives in Scranton, Pennsylvania, and he’s on the side of Keystone Staters.
Casey’s Republican opponent lives in Connecticut in an enclave on the Long Island Sound where the water meets wealth, and the wealthy meet each other.
The Connecticut candidate is on the side of lowering taxes for American oligarchs, and he’ll jump as high as the Florida felon tells him to.
Casey’s opponent doesn’t care about the people of Pennsylvania. Bob Casey does.
When I met with him recently, Bob spoke of his deep concern that childcare is so expensive for working moms and dads in his state. Senator Casey believes that parents should be able to have a family AND be part of the workforce—and he’s determined to solve this problem.
[**We all need to pitch in to keep Bob Casey in the Senate. Will you join me?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240628-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20240628-5&refcode2=3417_552475_VitM5_&akid=3417%2E552475%2EVitM5_)

---
Republicans are on a mission to take away women’s rights. If God forbid Senator Casey loses his seat, the cruelty crowd will have even more power to take away more of our rights.
[**Let’s use our grassroots power to re-elect Bob Casey to the Senate and keep Republicans at home where**** _they_****belong.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240628-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20240628-5&refcode2=3417_552475_VitM5_&akid=3417%2E552475%2EVitM5_)
Peter, it’s easy to think you can’t make a difference. But I’ve worked with many campaigns, and I can tell you that small donations add up, and the money you give today will help Bob’s campaign educate, organize, and motivate more voters.
I hope you’ll stay involved and continue to help in whatever ways you can.
Whatever you do, don’t give up. We can do this.
With gratitude and best wishes to you and your family,
— Carole

Eric Hovde and his right-wing allies have flooded Wisconsin with $16 million worth of campaign ads to dispel the fact that he’s an out-of-state carpetbagger and attack my record.

As they’ve poured eye-popping sums of money into this race, Eric Hovde has surged in the polls — **to the point where this is now a tied race.**

### **48 Hours Left! Help Us Meet Our Reporting Deadline!**

Dear Friends,

We’re just 48 hours away from a crucial reporting deadline, and your support can make all the difference! This is a pivotal moment for our campaign, and every dollar counts as we push to bring positive change to Alaska.

I and my team are dedicated to fighting for our Alaskan values in Congress and taking our seat back from Joe Biden’s close ally, Mary Peltola. We need your help to ensure we have the resources to keep up the fight. Your contribution will help us demonstrate our strength and commitment to the people of Alaska.

Can we count on you to step up and make a donation today? Together, we can ensure our team the support we needs to continue advocating for our great state -- and pushing back against Biden's anti-Alaska agenda!

subject: We Need Real Leadership: Support Dr. Cornel West for President
body:
Dr. West’s vision for his first 100 days in office is grounded in the principles of truth, justice, and love. Each milestone in his plan addresses systemic issues and sets the stage for transformative change. Here’s how:

| | |
---
* * *
---
### We Need Real Leadership: Support Dr. Cornel West for President
# Dear Peter
Last night's presidential debate made it abundantly clear: Joe Biden doesn't have both paddles in the water and is incapable of defeating the neo-fascist threat that Trump represents. We need a different kind of leadership in the White House—someone honest, decent, and committed to policies of material change. Dr. Cornel West is that leader. Dr. West’s vision for his first 100 days in office is grounded in the principles of truth, justice, and love. Each milestone in his plan addresses systemic issues and sets the stage for transformative change. Here’s how:
---
* * *
---
---
**Economic Justice:**
* Enact an executive order to abolish poverty and homelessness.
* Begin the process of establishing federal public banking to ensure equitable access to financial resources.
* Moving towards public oversight of the major monopolies and oligopolies.

**Education Justice:**
* Propose changes to school funding to promote educational equity.
* Facilitate community forums to engage and unite stakeholders in reforming education.
* Develop a national model for pursuing truth and justice for oppressed groups, especially Black, Indigenous, and Brown people.

**Environmental Justice:**
* Declare a climate emergency to address environmental crises truthfully.
* Establish a task force to halt new oil and gas leases, protecting natural resources and ensuring environmental justice.
* Outline initiatives for renewable energy that nurture the planet and future generations.

---
---
**Support our movement for change.** Donate today!
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=we_need_real_leadership_suppor&n=1 "Donate for Justice!") [Donate for Justice!](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=we_need_real_leadership_suppor&n=1)
---
---
|
---
| **Gender Justice:**
* Codify pregnant people's right to abortion and body autonomy.
* Publish the Equal Rights Amendment.
* Free menstrual products.

---
* * *
---
| **Global Justice:**
* Immediately stop all funding and weapons to Israel and promote genuine self-determination for Palestinians and Jews with equal dignity and security.
* Anti-Imperialist US Foreign policy that makes America a decent nation rather than an aggressive empire.
* Announce reductions in military expenditures, reallocating funds toward humanitarian efforts.

**Health Justice:**
* Sign an executive order to implement national, improved Medicare for All.
* Release initial findings from the healthcare study, committing to transparency in potential reforms.
* Invite public commentary on healthcare reforms to ensure community needs are met.

**Immigration Justice:**
* Draft legislation to reform immigration policies, focusing on humane treatment and family unity.
* Advancing amnesty at the American borders.
* Lift the blockade; normalize US relations with Cuba.

---
| **Racial Justice:**
* Conduct public hearings to discuss and promote reparations transparently - in the form of financial payments.
* Land back for Indigenous communities
* Ensure justice for Black farmers.

**Voter Justice:**
* Promote legislation for more inclusive voting practices, such as ranked-choice voting and proportional representation, ensuring every voice is heard.
* Organize community town halls to strengthen democratic participation.

**Worker Justice:**
* Direct the Department of Labor to draft a Workers' Bill of Rights, championing the right to organize and secure fair labor practices.
* Engage labor leaders in discussions to reinforce solidarity and worker empowerment.
* Publish and promote the finalized Workers' Bill of Rights, advocating for transparency and fairness in labor laws.

---
|
This strategic plan weaves the values of truth, justice, and love into the fabric of our nation. Dr. West’s leadership is the change we need—a leadership that listens, engages, and truly represents the people. But we can’t do it alone. We need your support to make this vision a reality. Your donation will help us reach more voters, spread our message, and build the momentum needed to elect Dr. Cornel West as our next President.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: two debates on CNN yesterday?
body:
Last night was the first Presidential Debate and it was...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

President Donald Trump and President Joe Biden weren’t the only debate on CNN yesterday.

Of course, I’m still trying to make sense of President Biden’s comments that women need abortion because, _“There’s a lot of young women are being raped by their in-laws, by their, by their spouses. Brothers and sisters . . .”_

So, President Biden thinks women get pregnant from . . . _sister rape? Or how about saying you are going to stop rapists and prevent rape instead of prescribing more killing of babies?_

**_The pro-abortion Left seriously needs to take some biology classes_!**

Anyway, I’m not sure it matters because seconds after the debate, Democrats were calling for replacing President Joe Biden as the party’s nominee.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gyulhtt-duchtdja-y/)
But there’s ANOTHER debate that’s going viral online right now that took place on CNN yesterday where Jim Acosta and I got into it about the Supreme Court’s EMTALA decision, and he simply shut me down because he didn’t like what I had to say.

I've added the video here if you haven’t seen it yet on Fox News, The Daily Caller, Yahoo, or any of the media outlets hammering the story right now . . .

I’m bringing this up because – while President Biden certainly looked out of it and frail last night – that’s not really who we’re up against.

He’s just a puppet for the Abortion Lobby, their pals in the press, academia, many major corporations, Big Tech . . . and the list goes on and on.

What they are really fighting for is late-term, even up-until-birth, taxpayer-funded abortion-on-demand FORCED on every state in the nation!

That’s why – _with the June 30 th **End of Quarter** rapidly approaching_ – it’s more critical now than ever that we show President Biden and the rest of the Abortion Lobby just how strong the Pro-Life Movement is.

**[So Pro-Life Friend, will you please consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ right away to help us fight back against their radical agenda](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gyulhtt-duchtdja-j/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

subject: The Senate is *the* backstop to protect our democracy

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6859%2E5257348%2EUOJ5XY ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, we
need to have an honest conversation about the Senate.

We must win the presidency at all costs. A second Trump presidency is
simply not an option. But defending our Senate majority in November is the
ultimate backstop to protect our democracy.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240628_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10%7D&t=1004&akid=6859%2E5257348%2EUOJ5XY ]Your
$10
donation right now — before my FEC fundraising deadline this Sunday — will
help me win this race in California and defend our Senate majority from
being run by the likes of Ted Cruz, JD Vance, Rick Scott, and the rest of
Trump’s cult of personality. Please chip in.

It is time for the American people to ask ourselves whether we really
believe MAGA Senators will vote to advance legislation that is remotely in
the best interests of the American people.

Derek, I can
tell you personally they are far more likely to be enablers of the GOP’s
Project 2025 — which seeks to wield the power of the presidency to remake
the government in Trump’s authoritarian image.

He could only do so with the help of the Senate.

A Democratic Senate majority could block any far-right judicial nominees,
including nominees to the Supreme Court.

A Democratic Senate majority could stand in the way of the far-right
takeover of federal agencies.

A Democratic Senate majority could block any efforts to privatize Medicare
and Social Security, extend and expand tax cuts for billionaires and
megacorporations, and hand out more corrupt deals to MAGA political allies
while thrashing the constitutional checks and balances that constrain any
wannabe despot.

If the party controlling the majority does not value their oaths of office
or the constitutional system of checks and balances, they can do enormous
damage. That’s why ensuring that Trump and his MAGA allies cannot drag
this body of government under his thumb is paramount.

I am determined to lead the effort to abolish the filibuster, protect
voting rights, and bring much-needed reform to the Senate. We must win our
race here in California and defend our majority in order to do so.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240628_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10%7D&t=1005&akid=6859%2E5257348%2EUOJ5XY ]Derek,
unlike many of Trump’s MAGA allies in the Senate, I don’t take a dime of
corporate PAC money — I need your help to compete with their millions.
Will you make a
$10
donation before midnight to help me reach our campaign’s FEC fundraising

As we round out Pride Month, today I want to tell you about how homophobia nearly destroyed my life.

As many of you know, I was publicly outed by my Republican opponent in the 90s.

But before that, in the 70’s, Proposition 6 nearly ended my career before it began.

**Proposition 6** was a ballot initiative that would have banned gays and lesbians from teaching in public college.

Similar initiatives passed in other states and right-wing activists were determined to pass it in California.

_**If it had passed, my 20+ year career in public teaching would never have been possible. And without that, I would never have been inspired to run for Congress.**_

So as you can see, right-wing hatred of the LGBTQ+ community has real, tangible effects on the lives of everyday LGBTQ+ people. And I’ve seen that firsthand my entire life.

That’s why I’m fighting so hard to be an advocate for LGBTQ+ folks and other minorities. And It’s why I’m fighting to flip the House blue so we can pass strong protections for vulnerable communities.

But Peter, I can’t do this without you. **I have a major End of Quarter fundraising deadline on Sunday and I still need to raise $5,000 to have the funds we need to succeed.**

[**Can I count on you to chip in $7 to fund my work and ensure I can keep fighting for LGBTQ people and other marginalized communities for years to come? clean_body: Proposition 6 | = As we round out Pride Month, today I want to tell you about how homophobia nearly destroyed my life. As many of you know, I was publicly outed by my Republican opponent in the 90s. But before that, in the 70’s, Proposition 6 nearly ended my career before it began. Proposition 6 was a ballot initiative that would have banned gays and lesbians from teaching in public college. Similar initiatives passed in other states and right-wing activists were determined to pass it in California. If it had passed, my 20+ year career in public teaching would never have been possible. And without that, I would never have been inspired to run for Congress. So as you can see, right-wing hatred of the LGBTQ+ community has real, tangible effects on the lives of everyday LGBTQ+ people. And I’ve seen that firsthand my entire life. That’s why I’m fighting so hard to be an advocate for LGBTQ+ folks and other minorities. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I can't believe I forgot this
body:
This is pretty important...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’ve sent you a few emails over the past few days about _Students for Life Action’s_ **End of Quarter Deadline,** but I forgot to mention one thing . . .

If you can give just **$12,** that will be enough for us to convert one pro-abortion/on-the-fence young voter to the Pro-Life Movement!

_Can you even buy a meal at McDonald’s for that these days?_

I know that may sound outlandish, but in the-lead up to Ohio's ballot referendum last fall, _Students for Life Action_ found we were able to convert one pro-abortion young voter on campus into a pro-life voter _for just $12._

The ONLY reason we came up short is that we couldn’t raise enough _money_ quickly enough to _convert_ enough young people to win.

**_Pro-Life Friend, I can’t bear to see that happen again in 2024 – not when just 0.003% of the vote decided the outcome in 2020_.**

**[So, will you consider agreeing to a generous contribution of $24 for ’24 to _Students for Life Action_ immediately](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gwjrll-duchtdja-y/)?**

Or, if that’s too much, could you give $12?

Whatever you can give, your support will be making a tremendous impact in helping us run digital ads targeted to young people, fund deployments of teams of canvassers in key Battleground States, and prove to the Abortion Lobby we’re not backing down.

For each of these deployments, we’re shipping off dozens of energetic pro-life students to identify, persuade, and ultimately turn out pro-life voters ahead of critical primary races as well as the general election.

In fact, just two weeks ago – _after Students for Life Action activists knocked on thousands of doors in their districts, handed out hundreds of flyers at churches, and made even more calls, texts, and emails_ – TWO of three South Carolina Republican State Senators who stood in the way of our pro-life efforts **_LOST_** their primary elections!

And the third one, Senator Katrina Shealy, was left facing a runoff election that ultimately ended in her defeat earlier this week!

This means pro-lifers like you and I might have a real chance of finally passing _Students for Life Actions's Life at Conception Act_ in South Carolina in 2025.

With your support, our goal is to reach 200,000 voters with in-person canvassing and make 150,000 phone calls in key districts nationwide before Election Day, just like we did in Sen. Shealy's district in South Carolina.

But all of this takes precious resources – resources I just don’t have laying around in our bank account right now.

And as more and more Americans are now “tuning in” to the race for the White House, there’s no time to waste.

Pro-Life Friend, as the **End of Quarter Deadline** approaches on June 30th, we have the perfect opportunity to demonstrate our momentum and convert tens of thousands of pro-life voters!

The Abortion Lobby, media elites, and Hollywood minions want to watch us fail . . .

And since _Students for Life Action_ doesn’t have deep-pocketed BILLIONAIRES like Bill Gates pouring truckloads of cash into our efforts like his foundation is doing with _Planned Parenthood,_ **we depend on the generosity of good men and women like you immensely.**

**[Your $12 contribution will enable _Students for Life Action_ to convert ONE pro-abortion young voter into a pro-life voter AND will ensure your End of Quarter support](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gwjrll-duchtdja-j/)!**

**[So, if you could give $24 for ‘24, that would be two pro-life young voters we’d be adding to our arsenal each month](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gwjrll-duchtdja-i/)!**

**[$36 would mean three new young people converted](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gwjrll-duchtdja-d/)!**

And that means A LOT in a close race when you combine your impact with the impact of thousands of other pro-lifers across the country.

Your contributions, combined with the gifts from other _Students for Life Action_ supporters, help create a snowball effect enabling us to make a **_big money impact_** that can finally defeat the Abortion Lobby.

You see, _Students for Life Action_ specializes in reaching voters aged 18-34 – a demographic virtually no one else on the political “Right” even bothers to talk to.

As the largest voting demographic in the country, even surpassing Baby Boomers, these are the voters President Biden is trying to schmooze before November.

**[So, your contribution of $36, $24, or even $12 hits President Biden where it hurts](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gwjrll-duchtdja-h/)!**

And with this critical June 30th **End of Quarter Deadline** rapidly approaching, it’s time to get to work.

Thank you for all you continue to do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt4q5afndtt0rh0migds6q2k3ppou04kbncootr8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimaoj1c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zasq8e4queub7q2lkmq6ot456ct6amp6lvilg6k8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimaoj1c5h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgfob0hvptuodedbfukcff51u5vb9t97648nbm68_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimaoj1c5h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn3m371bsmip1bnectupcfmckiepgge6e2ccdap8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdim6p32clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfbccr0b48ckdjh71gjluo8p5rclaejcb4cm4dg8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdim6p32clh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsv7n2uj04rpj5361q0sf2kd6q43vv99akehgt1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdim6p32clh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z79en6mg71p994ap0308uqm4b0doh5olkmna4kug_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimeo32clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3dda2evtqupha1va01qqk8dgudproi59mg6b7m8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimeo32clh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2za2g5srsfe9jqm160uh1o93r72bt6ev0plbuobk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdimeo32clh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:Dear Fellow Patriot,

My name is Dr. Ben Carson, and along with my wife, Candy, I have spent years contemplating the challenges facing American families today.

Our new book, _The Perilous Fight_ , addresses these issues head-on, offering practical insights and solutions to restore and strengthen the family unit.

Why is this important? Because the family's pivotal role in our society is under threat, and without addressing these challenges, our foundational values may be lost.[](http://trk.secureandprosper.-diim7q3gJfteUSfab1g)In _The Perilous Fight_ , we dive deep into the social and economic pressures that families face, dissect the erosion of traditional values, and present actionable steps for rebuilding familial bonds. This book isn't just a series of observations; it's a roadmap to a healthier, more stable society through strong family units.

**[**As someone committed to the promotion of truth and values, I am offering you access to the first chapter of our book for free. This limited-time offer will give you a glimpse into the vital issues we explore and the solutions we propose.**](http://trk.secureandprosper.)** I invite you to request access to your free chapter today if you want to:
* Understand the current challenges American families face;

* Discover actionable steps to strengthen your family and community; and

* Be part of a broader effort to uphold traditional values and promote societal stability

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfved7fh3b0psdh5e5pco7a330oi8j8cq6us7m9o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdhm0or6cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjpj4hiq1ibjrbhkc3ginikfa2ce7g81g43k2icg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34sdhm0or6cdh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL1q8zAYRq9G3hz0n7yDhg-Cpy8dunQU-nmVCCTbyHLb3H1xyQV0PQ8cDs_Hzd5cLnm-v7mKJpVm22YdWu_8syzz6BHHb8splyPVIwfLhmgogyjlgIadGWgJcKHDwwgUUaoL6KA0RCUdY8FDSl4ErUCnIZvDQzUHepZK0RNLkAQmYJFGDhyIpK5g66fUEONS3RxL9tj6s-G6tH4KSx2KefS-bkT8I3wifHqVesRjJnxai5s3Iqa9V1sx5r0SccXqciFcH3Bb9haQiKvDFwmuri7fZyKu0_93RS-SD83E9SuXkjd9JpLeD8FvQP_bTZ-G_wQAAP__wYtvQQ)

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL1q8zAYRq9G3hz0n7yDhg-Cpy8dunQU-nmVCCTbyHLb3H1xyQV0PQ8cDs_Hzd5cLnm-v7mKJpVm22YdWu_8syzz6BHHb8splyPVIwfLhmgogyjlgIadGWgJcKHDwwgUUaoL6KA0RCUdY8FDSl4ErUCnIZvDQzUHepZK0RNLkAQmYJFGDhyIpK5g66fUEONS3RxL9tj6s-G6tH4KSx2KefS-bkT8I3wifHqVesRjJnxai5s3Iqa9V1sx5r0SccXqciFcH3Bb9haQiKvDFwmuri7fZyKu0_93RS-SD83E9SuXkjd9JpLeD8FvQP_bTZ-G_wQAAP__wYtvQQ)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL1q8zAYRq9G3hz0n7yDhg-Cpy8dunQU-nmVCCTbyHLb3H1xyQV0PQ8cDs_Hzd5cLnm-v7mKJpVm22YdWu_8syzz6BHHb8splyPVIwfLhmgogyjlgIadGWgJcKHDwwgUUaoL6KA0RCUdY8FDSl4ErUCnIZvDQzUHepZK0RNLkAQmYJFGDhyIpK5g66fUEONS3RxL9tj6s-G6tH4KSx2KefS-bkT8I3wifHqVesRjJnxai5s3Iqa9V1sx5r0SccXqciFcH3Bb9haQiKvDFwmuri7fZyKu0_93RS-SD83E9SuXkjd9JpLeD8FvQP_bTZ-G_wQAAP__wYtvQQ)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6ParFhaX7DuS0UFyCw0njQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYmXAP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041MDg0NVcDc3BjQgpmfe7Xf2YQGAhkUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6ParFhaX7DuS0UFyCw0njQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYmXAP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041MDg0NVcDc3BjQgpmfe7Xf2YQGAhkUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6ParFhaX7DuS0UFyCw0njQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYmXAP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041MDg0NVcDc3BjQgpmfe7Xf2YQGAhkUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please participate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Yl9Uub4bwKuqUnoogYfg4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYnGWP0SraHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLUNCLTIwMjQwNjI5VwNzcGNCCmZ99dh_Zgl0QbxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Yl9Uub4bwKuqUnoogYfg4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYnGWP0SraHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLUNCLTIwMjQwNjI5VwNzcGNCCmZ99dh_Zgl0QbxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Yl9Uub4bwKuqUnoogYfg4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYnGWP0SraHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLUNCLTIwMjQwNjI5VwNzcGNCCmZ99dh_Zgl0QbxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Conservative Broadcast

| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a93eafc5d46e2b09e3c33c8d73b4e&_e=vmAPieLzlgzUAIHQ8GB8msYfV4BZ2PheC5qtlARYO0YmMcycUjUS1Z9Pa7cBlVD_4bAqGHFGKMziGKync7SeZw7h53vACr2K7HCjCvjyI_WL8r4R6PFLiyowFzp8idlnXgyJ2LGGHkrJbnaZBenSozLP-b0IPuHMSM5td2qdMvdsCPhRr45WycOp4HFvXypz2gfJK_20ve70Ks9-5aYN8zAh4W9fRrLPzpexwWhVKQcDuftF4sS7rc6HMrbJlEfXSg39GmGsjpefw2JcVJpql-Csh_JawvApz-OtS6tDdLwzM3Qi5GLNG01e0QTpV34uRHKeQS1cnVjN5SmikFlJegmYkEw1Y8R5pvOf1j7myfh_Z_VEPCmzJ2JUbMwHHwsCXuuYQpEDKiVB4NKBeHdkV9rUj9k3oypmznBqWLmtmZk%3D)

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a93eafc5d46e2b09e3c33c8d73b4e&_e=vmAPieLzlgzUAIHQ8GB8msYfV4BZ2PheC5qtlARYO0YmMcycUjUS1Z9Pa7cBlVD_4bAqGHFGKMziGKync7SeZw7h53vACr2K7HCjCvjyI_WL8r4R6PFLiyowFzp8idlnXgyJ2LGGHkrJbnaZBenSozLP-b0IPuHMSM5td2qdMvdsCPhRr45WycOp4HFvXypz2gfJK_20ve70Ks9-5aYN8zAh4W9fRrLPzpexwWhVKQcDuftF4sS7rc6HMrbJlEfXSg39GmGsjpefw2JcVJpql3DCZk0-wjhTnYcaX6lmcjx_noZXQmOsfIL8rVac-2_22k3FYAyl4Ik-YCIzJiTd5YxkKTdDwORwIwDOauGuPqXuc9Sxe2aQxioXKshDHch6pJwiQgV6zJxT6nWyWR5En9lFZ6R8JD_fC8aYWib5uLo%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a93eafc5d46e2b09e3c33c8d73b4e&_e=vmAPieLzlgzUAIHQ8GB8msYfV4BZ2PheC5qtlARYO0YmMcycUjUS1Z9Pa7cBlVD_4bAqGHFGKMziGKync7SeZw7h53vACr2K7HCjCvjyI_WL8r4R6PFLiyowFzp8idlnXgyJ2LGGHkrJbnaZBenSozLP-b0IPuHMSM5td2qdMvdsCPhRr45WycOp4HFvXypz2gfJK_20ve70Ks9-5aYN8zAh4W9fRrLPzpexwWhVKQcDuftF4sS7rc6HMrbJlEfXSg39GmGsjpefw2JcVJpql59fO-kuyncfSkkm-anTrhmUp5S1-vz6-LqNMPiUaxgr7bzhCPg5g5qH9OpPxDDv_zpdfxFb3hxMV_fIRJDWnyAa5iTid3uvaXYMSOGPT0tmAa28Wl6gYEyVeo6lTWoKplL-hE5l96JbK9APqnw5K7w%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a93eafc5d46e2b09e3c33c8d73b4e&_e=vmAPieLzlgzUAIHQ8GB8msYfV4BZ2PheC5qtlARYO0YmMcycUjUS1Z9Pa7cBlVD_4bAqGHFGKMziGKync7SeZw7h53vACr2K7HCjCvjyI_WL8r4R6PFLiyowFzp8idlnXgyJ2LGGHkrJbnaZBenSozLP-b0IPuHMSM5td2qdMvdsCPhRr45WycOp4HFvXypz2gfJK_20ve70Ks9-5aYN8zAh4W9fRrLPzpexwWhVKQcDuftF4sS7rc6HMrbJlEfXSg39GmGsjpefw2JcVJpql1kTMlT10Eb7fJV3c2qva-LOCl4PucoxNZn0jaD-Gfcr2EnMrsEDa_RD22lbvWRxsgXWwIuMF1DgCdnVYAjgt4FrT5dM9gfrqC0JyJeKwkSYBu2sNzOsniClXg8ZYiKMtoy-yhMufSbMfAy4ho0OGVo%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute
