After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith. In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith. Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed. This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life. Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith? Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America. Thank you for your consideration. ## SCOTUS Cuts Federal Agencies' Power
The Supreme Court overturned the [40-year-old Chevron deference doctrine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUxvGnwe4YQEQoKG5jN7fd0jBwcNigGMAx8_Ybt976S7788v96LA8bU9zX_3ZD00JerGvxjYsEroGLRXTeBESOQ4eGTUxLqUbFupeZnjKwwTEvrHhSH7SfRjpIL5UTVlnRRcMpF1RyzShlo-iZ0hOOVATqxDjogQiKPrZc-u8c9_bCkD75jaV3eeuSebV2VDL8I3wmfL6uqy94Niz13gmfE642ET6fFep5FNwQXD5LA3eWZ4WAHotNYFfc3QeOfGGpcP-3s-xxX4FpJeAo6NDj3uDWApXAFeFzV4w_rphSrHIigq6bjekX1v7O9Db8JwAA___sDWpu) in a major ruling on Friday. The doctrine had given federal agencies the power to interpret ambiguous laws and required courts to defer to their decisions. In a 6-3 ruling, the conservative justices reined in that authority, saying instead that [courts must independently decide](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u5CAYAJ8Gd1j8GZuC4hp3e-2VFoaP3e-EjQWsUd4-Ssoo5Wia0fx7bA-HCc_nX3eAbTFvzje8YdNUGCrUpoZgI4AAOYDlMzdaL9PCh5fdd7ZEDmHfdZBaz5pzE_0chJqBycUMaAUTimlhOGN8UiNfzAwTU5F5NUkjiWIQsOUy_s94thfE9JFvKKPPx5Dsq7WrEvmHiJWItfc-nrs_odcvT8R65YQNfSVire-rwAHU53dpP5kGSHhDqXRPudMrdyg0QoDiEnVPOD1CpcWfjqtJKjUUG66OKWHVM1HseThM303t90O3FZ8BAAD__ykralo) on regulatory interpretations, rather than agency officials. The decision, which reflects the [court's skepticism](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhSAYRp8GNwz8AsrA0MXtdu1ouPijtCgGUNO3b267dv-S75zz8ZgeNsSwL-92Q1N9mqyr4cJJUdAUxCSa2XhEwK5Bw3uulRrkwJvV9FwK7H2PUltQg_PAvVBewdwJLbtnEwwwEEyB5oxxKVo-6B4lE545ITvdEcFwDjXl9jOFva7o43e6MLcubU00a61HId0bgZHAeN93W1yqZ3nGtLwmBMbXAYGRKQJjOY-MG1KXzlxpqTl8YaFzunfqVrxy2qk7c_3TpUe6MdPkqccZs43ULri7gIXA2GQzH3eIMRTVE8GWzYb4C1X_T3QZ-AkAAP__lthpiw) toward expansive regulatory powers by the government, was celebrated by business and conservative groups.
## Uvalde Ex-Chief Indicted for Child Endangerment
Former Uvalde School District Police Chief Pete Arredondo was indicted on Friday on [10 counts of abandoning and endangering children](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQgOGnMRvIPh8QDx4qVWzpUlUdkbEPuMjYEThEefuqnTv_wy9939fx6jhyWj7cRrbMeXS-8EljV4OpAUesgp2JgHRFVvXKdN2lvahqtTBp6XrlyLcmSOW1QokmgAEdAKepYgsSUHZglJSqxUZdTE-txFl6bLXRAiUFLnlvbplTWWmOr3zS3vi8VdGupdwPod8EDAIGN_lEz6NZ8m8WMHx9Chgep4uB6mPNuXBa6mV3KdS3x_6qOQX2ZaNUBAxHyftL6IGD0O9KKTTSmL7abbg_OUY-ul6gXDbH8e9e_rc4LfwEAAD__wT6X4I) during the 2022 Robb Elementary School shooting that resulted in the deaths of 19 children and two teachers. [Arredondo is accused of](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7hwtaxZCQfGadHntlRaBJd4TNpbNObq_P-XqK0fTjObjPt2DFFmf_8PCvuU6hdjk5MkM6AbUk-6Tz8zIY89eWeWMudJV9bN3AJjVw3FgitYqq1CT5kxWPcaUUy8eATUYdApAkb6oq7NMoDNETaMbOw2cpNX98lllbTPn8l1P3i-xLn3xc2vb0Y3_Orx1eAvbyq_jrd6wN4mFO7x9naEkHo4411qGY661yfocZE0S28JrOwY2MIaYI1LUhMYRG0aXkiWjCBP0u0_bS0qRw9hOw3MJUn4b2t9HTo8_AQAA__-fDGGs) failing to identify the incident as an active shooter situation, not following established active shooter protocols, and causing significant delays in confronting the gunman. body:
What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e07fed20c240e0a7aa63e47fe51762&_e=_uuNNKBW_NvyaJDLG1FMGqx_u3swmbGKkGiGSXmN-aRlAuzeNDhgXGzb2Ecj055WXkfdhSayEixH-2K252EDu8neawh-aZK8q0_wzM0g18y9COsEOCpHeM0Rt--bMIU6-DyVRE8rVbiCTetT25Y0tpxse_QcHqCjlfvF2dqJlZ-TqMJHBb5NCxmG4B01nt1GXf-kf41MHcyjmpmbGTBFbvfcSi0MpvnNsXwd0t4_XvYhzTl4WrdbZZWLKwCC3vVPvxCV-1otw-w8PzHnPtJfY8IN5F3mVo8S739TgWGld8B7saH4Zp3-k67VvNC7DExsUpXgXBmU4ufd4hzJWY1mHC7ufNyhDumgY_a4IZSc1m5XDUv1WC4ouVIrLTNEbr2HsOrOB3ehNjuIvoOMmIYhsA%3D%3D)

| | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e07fed20c240e0a7aa63e47fe51762&_e=_uuNNKBW_NvyaJDLG1FMGqx_u3swmbGKkGiGSXmN-aRlAuzeNDhgXGzb2Ecj055WXkfdhSayEixH-2K252EDu8neawh-aZK8q0_wzM0g18y9COsEOCpHeM0Rt--bMIU6-DyVRE8rVbiCTetT25Y0tpxse_QcHqCjlfvF2dqJlZ-TqMJHBb5NCxmG4B01nt1GXf-kf41MHcyjmpmbGTBFbvfcSi0MpvnNsXwd0t4_XvYhzTl4WrdbZZWLKwCC3vVPd5jYGmsI8XiaFD2AD0dQzE9S82tThv4YdHFR4P5paZ8jZdQ_ui_UFlkrbBD6alVT6y0riZgZHBbLjwFgcnS30D8CqpfYuCwg6JRDUi34RqU_7DQJxzQs84is4VChe9OuXsZk_RE9Bs5vbc5ex4n3sQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e07fed20c240e0a7aa63e47fe51762&_e=_uuNNKBW_NvyaJDLG1FMGqx_u3swmbGKkGiGSXmN-aRlAuzeNDhgXGzb2Ecj055WXkfdhSayEixH-2K252EDu8neawh-aZK8q0_wzM0g18y9COsEOCpHeM0Rt--bMIU6-DyVRE8rVbiCTetT25Y0tpxse_QcHqCjlfvF2dqJlZ-TqMJHBb5NCxmG4B01nt1GXf-kf41MHcyjmpmbGTBFbvfcSi0MpvnNsXwd0t4_XvYhzTl4WrdbZZWLKwCC3vVPKpRMxkHfWYgsAG8sq0uFPAlPKkg2p_wX_ysbqNSGoaDiuDTfAMCf_UPcQqxAdJOORR7NWGYPAp-6LtWZ5eQ4xUtEa32K2003oNANH9OYuPQUTXr0UOxLTLmMfPsS-4iHEEGCIGnVN90GnixP21Nkfw%3D%3D)

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WE_SWc9MSnpvubQinhN2dA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYn_iP0TAaHR0cHM6Ly9vZmZlcnMuYW1lcmljYW5jb3JuZXJzdG9uZS5vcmcvcmVsaWdpb3VzLWxpYmVydHktc3VydmV5Lz91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249cmVsaWdpb3VzbGliZXJ0eXN1cnZleSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA2Mjkmc291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUNJMjMwNEVQMDAxVwNzcGNCCmZ-cuZ_Zug1U39SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WE_SWc9MSnpvubQinhN2dA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYn_iP0TAaHR0cHM6Ly9vZmZlcnMuYW1lcmljYW5jb3JuZXJzdG9uZS5vcmcvcmVsaWdpb3VzLWxpYmVydHktc3VydmV5Lz91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249cmVsaWdpb3VzbGliZXJ0eXN1cnZleSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA2Mjkmc291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUNJMjMwNEVQMDAxVwNzcGNCCmZ-cuZ_Zug1U39SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WE_SWc9MSnpvubQinhN2dA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoYn_iP0TAaHR0cHM6Ly9vZmZlcnMuYW1lcmljYW5jb3JuZXJzdG9uZS5vcmcvcmVsaWdpb3VzLWxpYmVydHktc3VydmV5Lz91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249cmVsaWdpb3VzbGliZXJ0eXN1cnZleSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA2Mjkmc291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUNJMjMwNEVQMDAxVwNzcGNCCmZ-cuZ_Zug1U39SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Hillsdale College via Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a9cc98f0157b44dba49456e276127505&_e=bdhnIaHbqzH2wD5HiLWtG4mf4SSgeVwmxayCP7h9NOds9IbVaJhWyZAxYbVsKKkn_OYmjwbMb9Q3K0h52nLyV_YKtg9nBXDQXx1tpG91OKhtROzZXh4Qz0KumswVFwMJ49-ukLjEomDcoHUX0iFDmaPS_4OXc6_l2eV6SGskMY2KDVxaas3UINaSLfyPa28iFpq82WxsnWnREL_9RXBEMuTup6zR658T4A8EoGSPzrox5WAf6dSs9N6qYsNuQJGZ7FqXJ_ISNcltevZWW5T-Un5H_kwB_TLgK_4eA5tAWsHk2dLkxRUmObwxCcvGZR9GClVYsF8TVD4TnxXCNIIWmpL9UR77RTKFmdyLAfkzpm-f7sb488sU1oKcpwzgWw5BGm4tgEb7y7h56Q-YPNpscA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a9cc98f0157b44dba49456e276127505&_e=bdhnIaHbqzH2wD5HiLWtG4mf4SSgeVwmxayCP7h9NOds9IbVaJhWyZAxYbVsKKkn_OYmjwbMb9Q3K0h52nLyV_YKtg9nBXDQXx1tpG91OKhtROzZXh4Qz0KumswVFwMJ49-ukLjEomDcoHUX0iFDmaPS_4OXc6_l2eV6SGskMY2KDVxaas3UINaSLfyPa28iFpq82WxsnWnREL_9RXBEMuTup6zR658T4A8EoGSPzrox5WAf6dSs9N6qYsNuQJGZ_s9W4lRJXlVwdstBrEfn-zb4A1Rf7j-cQctbkQY96EUH3vXMG7KgRgMC-KY5PIM5d9DAHaGN3LGYfDKq9Wyl_nVoD8kAR9reXsC4rsa-Ctgl6AWqMzm3BZTnuw5ZfverPbo1uTNHNgkGvjTpsDFPhg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a9cc98f0157b44dba49456e276127505&_e=bdhnIaHbqzH2wD5HiLWtG4mf4SSgeVwmxayCP7h9NOds9IbVaJhWyZAxYbVsKKkn_OYmjwbMb9Q3K0h52nLyV_YKtg9nBXDQXx1tpG91OKhtROzZXh4Qz0KumswVFwMJ49-ukLjEomDcoHUX0iFDmaPS_4OXc6_l2eV6SGskMY2KDVxaas3UINaSLfyPa28iFpq82WxsnWnREL_9RXBEMuTup6zR658T4A8EoGSPzrox5WAf6dSs9N6qYsNuQJGZWZwp4vhXr1NH6axFzKHgd9m6lwqPM00XH7u7CCuiRVlYN7kmkJBWepvnvE1YI5edHveyqdS9l2zPBqlflkfJummvxl_7otkpgXvW0bePZEiPGT3Hw528v_NHGjyOWBYv13xAtkbMr1LTn7xbNIunLQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

But this year, it’s tough to celebrate when extremist Republicans are doubling down on their hateful bills to target LGBTQ+ people like me.

They’re banning gender-affirming care for trans kids.

They’re targeting drag shows.

They’re silencing discussions about pronouns and LGBTQ+ history in schools.

They’re allowing religious entities to discriminate against LGBTQ+ people.

They’re forcing trans people to use bathrooms that don’t correspond to their gender identity...**and so much more.

**The recent uptick in anti-LGBTQ+ bills is not only heartbreaking; but also illustrates how long of a way we have to go to secure equal rights and protections for LGBTQ+ folks like me. And that starts with voting out every single homophobic, bigoted Republican at the ballot box.**

Peter -
No better way to celebrate Independence Day than stylishly exercising your 2nd Amendment rights. [www.endexfitness.com](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DMvyyJGZ1c7j69JdmHRNZuFWbVp5UZ7V2uZmzChuLGI4g7WdwHBTjdnS8A43ZhbB3vffqm6viakssAkKWL9oEAgBXrpXVK52whOucFNHk-a65CFn5iv9rS8rJlHKQwzNoEjLOvBBq8DuDugGI-ZXVQ==&c=yuHy746feZ7-vFt5f8aBwV67C-yxs6Jr9KWmF9v-EQUWUIrPtl-55w==&ch=9bnJiQ_mMqETbPpqs5H-auot5XQerWmqqlA9DA1hbWku9V3THajzpw==)
DISCLAIMER: No, I don't make a dime off of this. This is campaign merchandise, just not the cheesy kind. In fact, my campaign barely gets anything. The profits for this clothing line go almost entirely to funding US House races around the country and growing the Republican majority.
I'm seriously proud of this product. It's the best thing on the market. Hands down. We have spent almost a year developing it and patenting it. And the pants and shorts are basically perfect- stretchy, wrinkle proof material with a style and fit you can wear in literally any occasion. Hiking, swimming, golfing, or a board meeting with a blazer on.
So many brands try to sell you "sleek" holsters and belt systems for "concealed" carry. But there's nothing sleek about an extra inch of plastic or leather or metal clips, plus the belt. Our design keeps it simple with an improved belly band elastic holster that integrates into the pants perfectly. Or you can use the holster by itself. It's removable.
There's a difference between carrying and concealed carrying. Concealed should actually mean concealed. It should mean comfort and style that fits within your environment. If you want to go to the range (or war), then by all means get your favorite holster out. But concealed carrying means you're going to a regular public place, and you need to look the part. This design accomplishes that goal better than anything on the market.
Get it soon. This is our first drop and we didn't produce all that much. Enjoy!
In Service,

Dan Crenshaw

body:
We'll get straight to the point. | | |
---

🇺🇸 To all of Joe Biden's supporters and those who want to beat Donald Trump ⛅️ Please don't scroll past this. This isn't the first time we've emailed recently, so we'll get straight to the point.

_Tomorrow we close the books on the most important FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign to date._ When it's over, everyone will be looking at our numbers, comparing them to Trump's, and the outcome will shape the media coverage and even votes. So this is important.

| Dear Friend,

**Extreme left wing ideas are everywhere.** “Woke” ideology has spread from college campuses and now infects much of the public sector and corporate America.
---
| |
---
**To help families protect their children from the “woke” mind virus, I have written this illustrated children’s book,_What Makes America Special_. **

If we don’t teach our families about America, TikTok will. Don’t leave it to progressive professors to teach your children about America.
**Here’s a book that will make sure your children value America the way you do!**
---
| An immigrant to the United States, not a day goes by when I don’t marvel at how lucky I am to be living here.

I find it obscene that so many young Americans are being taught to always assume the worst about their own country.

**_What Makes America Special_** teaches six truths every child needs to know about this great country. It is based on the things I used to tell my own daughter about America soon after we made our home here.

**_Publication date is July 4 th – and to celebrate we are giving a free US flag with every order, plus a downloadable bonus Activity Book! _**

Fellow Patriot, Greg Abbott here.

I'm emailing you today because**I want you to know the truth. **

If you tune into the mainstream media or read statements from the Biden Administration and political pundits from the Left, you'll see they're flinging attacks our way.

_➡️ Blaming Texas for the border crisis.

➡️ Calling my actions to secure the border "shameful."

➡️ Suing Texas for stepping up to keep America safe from Biden's open border policies._

This is nothing new. In fact, Texas has long been the envy of our nation thanks to decades of strong conservative leadership. _That 's why I've never shied away from the fight to keep our state a beacon of prosperity, freedom, and law and order._

As Joe Biden and his open border regime continue to ignore their duty to secure our border, Texas is facing their border crisis head-on, using every tool and strategy to defend our border. This approach has made Texas the target of _EVEN MORE_ attacks from the Left. Biden is weaponizing the Department of Justice to obstruct our historic border security efforts.
**But let me be perfectly clear: Texas will not back down from our fight at our southern border and in the courtroom, too.**
No matter what the Biden Administration continues to throw our way, Texas will continue to work day and night to do what it takes to keep America safe.

_But as strong as Texas may be, I cannot lead this fight alone. _

That's why, if you can spare it, **[I'm asking for your support today,](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d9af88f9ed4946c5b738d53447b91a84&_e=HlxsESUgKMrdnEmcj6gwHL3pSElZr8kxkR35QhGsUfwlNAzt5u2tIoJnDgXo3qLd2g1iEoCPGQwgrWmudWYcb4wfyS7eP5_JSu9DwLwDtwq8oThUMEa-SjUJhPuR7n8po8M1P6hyW0zXoNI5kz2BeIhoRT1Yamhdwga-FjoSwOc8GeszZF0LWmZJh3F3j0ME_W1Kr4qOdtBobHcNNsakmzdhGapG-ydeHFeHTzBruV2dj0QRR1VpSeAv8DSzA9MTWNW8ZDTL6LX5qjrbmgGk3LnnswQCrrjAmCibBxWuguZ3yDUqNQXwKwl6k0tKCw6U-0ZjXLm_gl9z06FtBN0xBb0ZZSj1RMZxx3kwNWA12uvWgDmai2ZKoacm-Ei9-uRQ3C1LZhP6MuxcMp3CE4QXNQ%3D%3D)** %%=Propercase(first_name_most_recent)=%%.

The Biden Administration and their friends in the media want YOU to believe the southern border is secure and this crisis is nonexistent. They don't want leaders like me exposing the truth.

With attacks ramping up as we head toward the November election, will you consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fight back and get our message out to the American people? **[Follow the link here to contribute any amount now.->](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d9af88f9ed4946c5b738d53447b91a84&_e=HlxsESUgKMrdnEmcj6gwHL3pSElZr8kxkR35QhGsUfwlNAzt5u2tIoJnDgXo3qLd2g1iEoCPGQwgrWmudWYcb4wfyS7eP5_JSu9DwLwDtwq8oThUMEa-SjUJhPuR7n8po8M1P6hyW0zXoNI5kz2BeIhoRT1Yamhdwga-FjoSwOc8GeszZF0LWmZJh3F3j0ME_W1Kr4qOdtBobHcNNsakmzdhGapG-ydeHFeHTzBruV2dj0QRR1VpSeAv8DSzA9MTK6epl6Kz0UYp8ueuXId6NBd0FWRpoJhoDE7MlD2Mk6plyidkuWR6YxrkXVHJZfDMGR-h6UBUYIlNtmpCi4puphrizygKpvNIft4yHgNs05H51HHOOJ1O-a2gdmRH7sIEkoWuFyb7CNFR0BXNYIKDzg%3D%3D)**

If doing what's right for America makes me the subject of criticism from the Left, so be it. In Texas, I will continue our historic border fight and _HOLD THE LINE_ until we have an America First leader back in the White House who will secure our border once and for all.

This is about protecting the future of the country we love, %%=Propercase(first_name_most_recent)=%%, and that is a fight worth fighting for me.

**[If that is something you agree with, I'm asking you today - if you are able - to chip in a donation of $5, $10, or even $100 to play a role in defending our future.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d9af88f9ed4946c5b738d53447b91a84&_e=HlxsESUgKMrdnEmcj6gwHL3pSElZr8kxkR35QhGsUfwlNAzt5u2tIoJnDgXo3qLd2g1iEoCPGQwgrWmudWYcb4wfyS7eP5_JSu9DwLwDtwq8oThUMEa-SjUJhPuR7n8po8M1P6hyW0zXoNI5kz2BeIhoRT1Yamhdwga-FjoSwOc8GeszZF0LWmZJh3F3j0ME_W1Kr4qOdtBobHcNNsakmzdhGapG-ydeHFeHTzBruV2dj0QRR1VpSeAv8DSzA9MTuUQ47ZGZdczZiHEoH8ZyJM5Bbcbc0Vn5G0TehWeVT-sGRwKGBtqbTLqjGKRQXNwsH82a_WiUfraa0O1zDlqqETijfk3DCTnGpeVBSXSp847KTnGzhAk6hfMu4W3fRUlVFSERwvB7YMisfrk_xh3htQ%3D%3D)** _Every dollar no matter the amount makes a big impact. _

Greg Abbott

name: Sarah McBride
subject: We’ve still got work to do!
body:
I truly couldn’t do any of this without you (or the coffee)!
#
Good morningteam! As I get ready for the busy day ahead, I wanted to take a quick moment to reach out to you.
Not only am I focused on wrapping up my work in the State Senate before the session ends tomorrow — but in the next 24 hours, our campaign is facing our biggest test yet: **the last end-of-quarter FEC deadline before the candidate filing deadline and primary election.**
**We’ve still got some work to do to reach our $25,000 fundraising goal, so I just made a big pot of coffee to keep me going!**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240629-1?refcode=em20240629-1-725&amount=5&refcode2=725_21716_bnFPSO&akid=725%2E21716%2EbnFPSO)
[**Can you pitch in $5 or any amount that works for you before 11:59 pm ET tomorrow to help us reach our $25,000 goal and help me become Delaware’s next member of Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240629-1?refcode=em20240629-1-725&amount=5&refcode2=725_21716_bnFPSO&akid=725%2E21716%2EbnFPSO)
This is our most important deadline for two reasons:
**After tomorrow, our campaign is legally required to make our fundraising numbers public** — and if we show _any_ signs of weakness, that could open the floodgates for outside spending from right-wing donors against us.
Plus, the team and I have big plans to communicate with voters and win this seat in Congress, but we can’t put them into action if we don’t meet our fundraising goals. And I’m counting on your support to help us do it!
So just like my morning coffee keeps me going, **grassroots supporters like you keep this campaign going** by donating $5, $25, $50 or whatever you can at a time. I truly couldn’t do any of this without you (or the coffee)!
I’m not exaggerating when I say this: **Pitching in to help us reach this goal is the single most important thing you could do today to help me win this campaign. It’s *that* important!**
[****So, please don’t wait until the deadline has passed. Pitch in before 11:59 pm ET tomorrow to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal and win in November:****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240629-1?refcode=em20240629-1-725&amount=5&refcode2=725_21716_bnFPSO&akid=725%2E21716%2EbnFPSO)

Thanks so much!
Sarah McBride

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After being pummeled with $20 million from right-wing outside spending,
Rep. Jamaal Bowman lost his primary election in NY-16 on Tuesday. This was
the most expensive House primary in U.S. electoral history, with
Republican megadonors using AIPAC’s Super PAC to spend over $17 million
against our progressive incumbent.

Despite this disappointing news, Jamaal remains one of the most
transformational leaders of our generation. He has become a political
force who, alongside the rest of the Squad, has changed the trajectory of
American politics and the urgency we expect from our elected leaders.

We recruited Jamaal to run for Congress in 2020 because his life’s work
has been deeply rooted in serving his community — as a loving father,
husband, and community leader serving children and working families as a
principal and leading advocate for public education in NYC for over 15
years.

Jamaal was an underdog from the beginning, with our progressive movement
always facing an uphill battle. From the moment Justice Democrats
candidates are recruited to run, they are up against decades of
establishment infrastructure and multi-million dollar war chests fueled by
right-wing millionaires and billionaires.

The work of Justice Democrats is to break down the barriers that exist for
people like Jamaal Bowman to run for Congress. Through your contributions,
we have:

* Worked directly with Jamaal’s campaign to help them knock on 170,000
doors and make over 1,000,000 phone calls to voters this calendar
year;
* Raised the campaign over $200,000 directly from all of you on our
email list;
* Spent more than $1,300,000 on the independent expenditure side, making
us the largest outside group spender supporting Jamaal;
* Poured hundreds of staff hours into the campaign, stepping into key
management and communications roles when gaps existed, and closely
coordinating with and supporting Jamaal’s campaign staff.

Jamaal’s historic victory over 30+ year AIPAC darling Rep. Eliot Engel and
his courage on many key issues, especially on Israel’s genocide, made him
a top target.

Jamaal and our movement were such a threat to right-wing power, to GOP
megadonors, and to AIPAC’s influence in Congress that they had to spend
$15 million to defeat us. This demonstrates the power of our people-funded
movement, the strength that any single progressive with the moral clarity
to stand up to far-right interests has, and just how on defense AIPAC
really is.

For AIPAC — the single largest spender in American politics including the
presidency to date — this race is so much bigger than re-electing a
Congressman. It is part of their final attempts to stop a rising tide of a
new generation of voters and leaders who refuse to stay silent in the face
of injustice at home or abroad.

AIPAC knows the future is not on their side, so they have no choice but to
overwhelm, confuse, and depress voters with a flood of dark money to
generate support for their candidates. That’s exactly why they pledged to
spend an unprecedented $100 million to unseat the Squad this year.

The sheer quantity of spending against our progressive champions proves to
us that our mission is not only a just and popular one that represents the
interests of the majority, but it is such a threat to the existing power
structures that they will spend more money than they ever have in their
history to try to silence us. It is up to us as a progressive movement,
and as a Democratic Party as a whole, to stand up and change this system
that sacrifices regular people for megadonors.

Win or lose, we know that primaries leave their mark on history and we
will never go back to a world where it is a given that members of Congress
will sell out our most marginalized communities and back down to corporate
interests. We will never go back to a world where all of Congress stays
silent as tens of thousands of people are murdered. Our members
relentlessly stand for a more just world for all people, even when it
threatens their own careers and well-being — as Jamaal selflessly did.

Now that this critical primary fight is over, we know AIPAC is shifting
gears and setting its sights on the next one: Rep. Cori Bush’s competitive
Democratic primary on August 6 in Missouri’s 1st district. We cannot give
in to hopelessness or cynicism — we must fight back, NOW.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240629.8NjS3z&refcode=em20240629-35522&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35522%2E1203867%2E77NcyL ]We need the grassroots resources to help protect Cori from AIPAC and
other right-wing attacks. Will you make a $5 contribution
right now to help us re-elect her and the rest of the Squad this year?

#### An appeal to honesty from the press will, sadly, go unanswered.

#### By Christine Flowers
---
| "I am not a journalist. I have never pretended to be a journalist."

"... The reason I am not a journalist is because I do not pretend to be unbiased. I do not usually do my own original investigation unless the story has something to do with immigration, an area in which I can confirm my expertise.

Other than that, what you get in these columns is opinion supported by more opinion, and sprinkled with a bit of necessary fact.

Most of the readers who disagree with me have already figured that out, by calling me a hack.

That’s Ms. Hack, Esquire, by the way. My primary job is lawyering. My hobby is opinionating."

name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Debate
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e803ad1be3&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Well, many people’s worst fears were realized on Thursday, as President Biden had the most dismal and depressing performance in the history of presidential debates.

I had seen President Biden live in February. He did not look good. He was old and shuffling, his skin translucent. His delivery of remarks was uneven and performative – when he says something that is supposed to have emotion behind it but it seems like an old guy reading lines instead of genuine sentiment.

Still, I figured that his team had figured out a regimen to make him seem pumped up and energetic for 90 minutes – they seemed to have it pretty well managed for the State of the Union. I thought if they give him a week of rest and preparation Joe would probably be able to channel some of his vigor from his many debates of 2020, and he’d be genuinely fired up to debate Trump.

I was wrong. It was a doddering disaster.
---
|
---
| One thing that was always in the back of my mind - a debate is a LOT harder than giving a speech off of a teleprompter. You have to have command of the material and some messages memorized. You have to project energy in response to your opponent and in some cases the moderators. Let’s say I had you memorize a 60-second message to camera. You’d have to be able to bust that out on command after 80 minutes of back and forth. It’s a lot of cognitive loading.

If someone asked me to give a good speech off of a teleprompter, I could do that with almost no notice. If someone asked me to do a great job at a televised debate it would take some runway. This was a much higher hurdle to clear than the State of the Union, and Joe Biden essentially faceplanted on the first lap.

So what happens now?

I’m clearly in the camp that Joe Biden should step aside and let the Democrats nominate someone else. A ticket of well-liked governors would be a much tougher foil for Trump than Joe and Kamala at this point. I got the hashtag #swapJoeout trending at one point.

The New York Times, the Atlantic, and even CNN have all piled on to make the same case. It’s been a remarkable shift. It’s tough to imagine a successful Democratic campaign that has lost the media to this degree.

But the Biden camp is digging in. The flagship Democrats – Obama, Harris, Newsom, Clyburn, Jeffries, Schumer – are circling the wagons, at least publicly. Donors are being managed and told to stay steady. Biden is campaigning away to try to demonstrate vitality. They have internalized the lesson – that has been true in the past – that if you hunker down you can weather any storm. Each passing day gives them more distance from the debate.

Still, behind the scenes some of the other candidates-in-waiting are staffing up and preparing.

Most debates don’t change a race fundamentally. This one is an exception – Americans saw firsthand that the President isn’t up to the job. He is running an unwinnable race. He is making the case that he is running to defend democracy, but then clinging to the office.

Joe Biden’s superpower has been that he’s a good man who will do right by the country. He is doing wrong by the country now. The question is whether anyone around him will have the courage and moral clarity to save him, and the rest of us, from himself.

If the debate made you wish for a new party in American politics, check out [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=52954943c1&e=0f227c2ae3) – we are growing every day and got a lot of new recruits this week.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=03ef4432f9&e=0f227c2ae3)
[andrewyang.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cd70e3b607&e=0f227c2ae3)

name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: The Missouri I grew up in taught us to take care of each other.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Josh Hawley could never understand that. Please let me explain:
#
Peter — Josh Hawley could never understand the Missouri I grew up in.
**Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)
On the right is Joshua Hawley. While his banker daddy was sending him to a fancy prep school miles from his hometown, my family and I were relying on our neighbors to survive bankruptcy and medical bills in mid-Missouri — in a community where people took care of each other. That’s us on the left.
When Hawley graduated from law school, he joined one of the world’s most elite corporate law firms. I joined the Marine Corps to pay back the community in Missouri that took care of me and my family. And when he was climbing the ladder to become another corrupt politician, I was serving my country — and then working to prevent the pointless overseas wars that make us less safe.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)
While Josh Hawley aligned himself with the same giant corporations who’ve spent decades attacking Missouri workers and shipping away our jobs, I’ve been fighting to take back power for American workers and small businesses.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)
And when Hawley voted against relief for veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits, I stood up alongside thousands of veterans to hold him accountable.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)
**The Missouri I grew up in taught us to take care of one another.** To do your duty. To serve and sacrifice for your fellow Missourians.
**Josh Hawley doesn’t know that Missouri — and on January 6th, 2021, he showed us the only thing he’s learned is how to be a fraud and a coward.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)
Josh Hawley hasn't just abandoned our state and our values. He's embarrassed himself and all of Missouri. And embarrassing Missouri... that’s something I can't let go.
**Missourians deserve a U.S. Senator who will stand up and fight for them — and unlike Josh, I'm ready to serve.** If you’re ready to help us make sure every Missouri voter knows it before they vote on Election Day, I need your help:
**[Will you chip in any amount to our campaign right now so we can get our message in front of voters? The only way we’ll be able to flip this Senate seat is if we build a powerful grassroots movement, and support from real people like you is the best way we can do it.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=9&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=10&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=11&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54618?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=12&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54617?refcode=em20240629-5893&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=5893%2E614464%2Eb25mAz)

Pennsylvania is one of the GOP’s top targets to flip this November.
| | |
---
Hi Derek,
I know you receive a good number of emails, so I’m hoping you take the time to read this one. Pennsylvania is one of the GOP’s top targets to flip this November in their efforts to take back the Senate and the White House.
My opponent, David McCormick, has spent more than seven figures on an ad campaign with the support of billionaires from Wall Street.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.

You might be wondering how this kid...

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1015&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive
races in the entire country.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1016&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters
after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because
that’s all we could afford.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1017&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I
worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1018&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into
college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the
country that gave me so much.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1019&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us
“Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest
Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends
over there.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27274?t=1020&amount=25&akid=1923%2E52803%2EcbrsBD ][IMG]

You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had
to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people

body:
I spent 90 minutes debating on a stage with a guy who has all the morals of an alley cat.
---
I spent 90 minutes debating on a stage with a guy who has all the morals of an alley cat. I mean, did you see Donald Trump? _He must have set a new record for the number of lies ever told in a single debate._ He lied about what a great economy he created, when we all remember the pandemic. He lied about how great he was for veterans, when we can recall how he called veterans who had given their lives for this country “suckers” and “losers.” **And he even lied about how he had nothing to do with January 6th.** **But we all saw it _with our own eyes._ We saw the mob attack the Capitol. We saw the police being attacked. The Capitol ransacked.** Folks, for all of Trump’s lies, we did learn some important truths. _We learned he is still proud of being the person who killed Roe v. Wade.
We learned that he wants another giant tax cut for the very wealthy and biggest corporations.
And that he’ll cut your Medicare, your Social Security, and cut your health care to pay for it.
_Most dangerously -- though -- we learned again that Donald Trump will not respect the outcome of this year’s election.__ Donald Trump showed us who he is. We have to believe him. [**I know you understand there is too much at stake to leave this election up to chance, so I have to ask: Will you split a $7 contribution between the DNC and Kamala’s and my campaign today? I spent 90 minutes debating with a guy who has all the morals of an alley cat Thursday night. I know I’m not a young man. I don’t walk as easily as I used to. I don’t speak as smoothly as I used to. _I don’t debate as well as I used to._ _I also know how to tell the truth.
I know right from wrong.
I know how to do this job.
I know how to get things done._ **I know --_like millions of Americans know_ \-- when you get knocked down, you get back up.** I would not be running again if I didn’t believe with all my heart and soul that I can do this job. Because, quite frankly, the stakes are too high. # Review Proposals and Submit Feedback
on I-65/I-70 Redesign by June 30!
---
For over 50 years, interstate highways have divided many downtown neighborhoods instead of connecting them. I am proud to partner with organizations like the Rethink 65/70 Coalition and Propel Indy to talk to people about what Indy's next 50 years could look like if we centered these communities instead.

Planners and advocates need to hear from you, too! Learn more about the proposal to reimagine our downtown interchange at [rethink65-70.org](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnJldGhpbms2NS03MC5vcmcvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDYyOS45Njk1MzgwMSJ9.bfdReVDn-49Dxr7Unu8stwJj3P6pc-6mrgTbVSet34I/s/2950175210/br/245010815630-l) & share your thoughts at [propelindy.com](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHJvcGVsaW5keS5jb20vIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDYyOS45Njk1MzgwMSJ9.X1PNSzWDGuwsxY8A8AUfo0sGq6pwJxZn7yKdO32Qkcs/s/2950175210/br/245010815630-l). Submissions close on Sunday!

## STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE
[IndyGo awarded $22M for work on Blue Line, Washington Street](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDgsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbWlycm9yaW5keS5vcmcvaW5kaWFuYXBvbGlzLWluZHlnby1ibHVlLWxpbmUtd2FzaGluZ3Rvbi1zdHJlZXQtMjItbWlsbGlvbi1ncmFudC8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNjI5Ljk2OTUzODAxIn0.flv26w4UdrGamMo5qg1YYYUL1gWc3sEQ4Xsfi6Z8e8g/s/2950175210/br/245010815630-l)
It's so exciting to see the Blue Line continue to marshal resources that will go to benefit the East Side and our entire city with traffic-calming measures and accessibility enhancements on Washington Street!
[New warning: Indiana could face a power shortage if state doesn’t act soon](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDksInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lnd0aHIuY29tL2FydGljbGUvbmV3cy9sb2NhbC9uZXctd2FybmluZy1pbmRpYW5hLWNvdWxkLWZhY2UtcG93ZXItc2hvcnRhZ2UtaWYtc3RhdGUtZG9lc250LWFjdC1zb29uLzUzMS02Yzk1NjU4NS02MzNmLTQyN2UtODlmOC1mMTVjYTdjZmVkZWE_cmVmPWV4aXQtcmVjaXJjJmZiY2xpZD1Jd1pYaDBiZ05oWlcwQ01URUFBUjBoN2FPZHA5MlIwdzBkX19VZ25qYzVUVzExNmpwRy16bzNCUXZYb28wZEFsblExazNMYzZQaHNFd19hZW1fT1Nsc291MFgybU1ab1U3dmRybnBwQSIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDA2MjkuOTY5NTM4MDEifQ.iCpXQvVcw0rHCoIIMfkSAUIKbLLVKp1YbcHTeb_8jko/s/2950175210/br/245010815630-l)
Expert analysis indicates that our state is already struggling to produce enough electricity for all, especially in the hot summer months. This is a warning call: it's time to update our aging grid and finally, meaningfully invest in renewable energy.
[Federal ruling against Healthy Indiana Plan potentially jeopardizes program](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTAsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYWNhcGl0YWxjaHJvbmljbGUuY29tLzIwMjQvMDYvMjcvZmVkZXJhbC1ydWxpbmctYWdhaW5zdC1oZWFsdGh5LWluZGlhbmEtcGxhbi1qZW9wYXJkaXplcy1wcm9ncmFtLyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDA2MjkuOTY5NTM4MDEifQ.Aex4ZlOGbLlt5ftADUq6Ej9hN-jEXwctnE87BL-7ZSE/s/2950175210/br/245010815630-l "Federal ruling against Healthy Indiana Plan potentially jeopardizes program")
A federal judge ruled this week that HHS wrongfully approved certain aspects of Indiana's HIP 2.0 Medicaid expansion, including the cost-sharing POWER accounts and lack of retroactive coverage. As state leaders, we must act with urgency to protect Medicaid coverage and do away with these unnecessary premiums and penalties. The health of vulnerable Hoosiers is far too important to risk.

Planners and advocates need to hear from you, too! Learn more about the proposal to reimagine our downtown interchange at & share your thoughts at . Submissions close on Sunday! | | STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE It's so exciting to see the Blue Line continue to marshal resources that will go to benefit the East Side and our entire city with traffic-calming measures and accessibility enhancements on Washington Street! Expert analysis indicates that our state is already struggling to produce enough electricity for all, especially in the hot summer months. This is a warning call: it's time to update our aging grid and finally, meaningfully invest in renewable energy. "Federal ruling against Healthy Indiana Plan potentially jeopardizes program" A federal judge ruled this week that HHS wrongfully approved certain aspects of Indiana's HIP 2.0 Medicaid expansion, including the cost-sharing POWER accounts and lack of retroactive coverage. As state leaders, we must act with urgency to protect Medicaid coverage and do away with these unnecessary premiums and penalties. The health of vulnerable Hoosiers is far too important to risk. | COMMUNITY RESOURCES To view my state government resource guide, "Hunley Community Resource Guide". | | | | | Created and distributed by the Indiana Senate Democratic Communications Office Shenetha.Shepherd@iga.in.gov Kyle.Casteel@iga.in.gov Molly.Neary@iga.in.gov ---|---|--- SUBSCRIBER SERVICES: | | |

| Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of the worst things to ever happen to the Senate. It will take years for our country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption, cronyism, extremism, and obstruction. But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse. He oversaw one of the biggest Medicare frauds in U.S. history and used the money to buy his seat. Then he wrote the plan to raise taxes on working families and end Medicare and Social Security. THEN, he co-sponsored a nationwide ban on abortions that could send doctors to prison. All that destruction and he's only been in the Senate for a single term. Imagine what he could do as GOP Leader. In short — Rick Scott shouldn't be allowed to step foot in the U.S. Senate, let alone lead the GOP caucus, whether they have the majority or not. But with McConnell out of the way, Scott is under the impression that this will be an easy win. I need your help to prove him wrong. [This is a make-or-break moment not just for my campaign but for our entire country. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! | Peter,

I believe deep in my bones that no corporation is above the law, and I’m proud to be the only candidate in the race for NH-02 who has publicly pledged not to take any corporate PAC money.

Our campaign is dedicated to delivering on the promise of government that works for the people, by the people. But I need your help to send a clear message that our democracy is not for sale.

**When corporate PAC money floods into our elections, the voices of everyday people are drowned out.**

name: Mari at United We Dream Action
subject: My sister is shut out of DACA
body:
DACA was never enough — it left my sister out. | | | Peter, DACA is never going to be enough. Not for the millions who never got to apply, and not for the millions more who were never eligible, **like my little sister.** Immigrant youth are living in limbo — either living with temporary DACA protections (which will likely be in front of the Supreme Court before long) or no protections at all. If she had DACA protections, my little sister would be able to go to school and get financial aid. Her immigration status wouldn’t get in the way of applying for jobs, and she would be able to live her life free from worrying about deportation. DACA is life-changing, Peter. **But now more than ever, it’s not enough.** Millions of undocumented immigrants are shut out of the program. Even DACA recipients can’t rest easy, as the case is likely headed to the conservative Supreme Court. **We need permanent protections now — so we can apply for jobs, get an affordable education, access health care, and live our lives proudly and free from the threat of deportation.** United We Dream Action was part of the coalition that helped win DACA back in 2012, and now twelve years later we’re leading the charge to secure a pathway to citizenship for ALL undocumented people. **[This fight isn’t easy, which is why I’m asking for your support: Will you chip in $10 or more to join our clean_body: DACA was never enough — it left my sister out. | | | Peter, DACA is never going to be enough. Not for the millions who never got to apply, and not for the millions more who were never eligible, like my little sister. Immigrant youth are living in limbo — either living with temporary DACA protections (which will likely be in front of the Supreme Court before long) or no protections at all. If she had DACA protections, my little sister would be able to go to school and get financial aid. Her immigration status wouldn’t get in the way of applying for jobs, and she would be able to live her life free from worrying about deportation. DACA is life-changing, Peter. But now more than ever, it’s not enough. Millions of undocumented immigrants are shut out of the program. Even DACA recipients can’t rest easy, as the case is likely headed to the conservative Supreme Court. We need permanent protections now — so we can apply for jobs, get an affordable education, access health care, and live our lives proudly and free from the threat of deportation. United We Dream Action was part of the coalition that helped win DACA back in 2012, and now twelve years later we’re leading the charge to secure a pathway to citizenship for ALL undocumented people. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HxkIVtN2yTEHj0S9CInSAg~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HxkIVtN2yTEHj0S9CInSAg~~/AARclAA~~~) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HxkIVtN2yTEHj0S9CInSAg~~/AARclAA~~~)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HxkIVtN2yTEHj0S9CInSAg~~/AARclAA~~~)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:
This would make my finance director’s head spin
| Team—

Look, I don’t expect everyone to contribute each time we send one of these emails. But the truth is we’re a little bit behind on the fundraising targets we need to hit to win this election.

We have to catch up. Fast. But I’m about to say something that would make my finance director’s head spin—**the amount you give doesn’t matter to me.** Here’s why:

I’m proud to run this campaign _the right way_ —with over 500,000 individual contributions from folks like you powering everything we do.

My opponent has the backing of shady billionaires and Mitch McConnell himself. Outside groups are flooding Montana with over **$50,000,000** in TV ads to try and defeat me.

I won’t lie, that’s a lot of cash. And it’s concerning—especially if we don’t have the resources to fight back. But I’d bet on this grassroots team any day of the week.

$10 here and $25 there might not seem like a lot, I know, but I promise it adds up. I wouldn’t be emailing you if your support didn’t make a difference.

[**So what do you think? Can you split a donation today (of any amount) between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us catch up on our goals and build the kind of grassroots campaign that can take on dark money and win?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/71054?t=6&akid=15366%2E878179%2ECjYyvX) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/71055?t=7&akid=15366%2E878179%2ECjYyvX)

| Peter,

It’s been the greatest honor of my life to represent Washington’s 6th Congressional District for 36 years. This year, we have an opportunity to elect someone new to represent us, and I hope you will join me today in supporting Hilary Franz.

For over seven years, Hilary has managed our state’s public lands and waters and guided our wildfire strategy with skillful leadership, innovation, and a commitment to the people she serves. Whether it’s tackling the high cost of living, standing up for our veterans, creating good-paying jobs in our community, or addressing our other pressing challenges, **I trust Hilary to get the job done.**

Friend, It’s not going to be easy. But that’s not why we’re in this fight, is it? Winning our North Coast district and helping our great country reverse course after years of disastrous one-party rule — empowered by the radical Democrat incumbent I’m facing — was never going to be easy. **But here’s something that is** : making a huge difference for our movement by **[helping my campaign raise another $7,500 to reach our crucial End of Second Quarter goal before midnight Sunday night!](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BTA8bcO8P1NURjZiPY967d2gHnl8MiBPq66ZmGlq504jPEXuElV3ZxNP5_A0tcN9q4&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=solid_democratic_they_say&n=2)** Friend, 16 years serving in the U.S. military taught me that things worth fighting for seldom are easy. Pundits say a Republican can never be competitive in the 2nd District. I’m determined to prove them wrong by ending the disastrous twelve-year run of my radical leftist opponent — and help reverse the disastrous course our country has been taken down.

If you can help me, there’s no better time! name: Mark Kelly & Ruben Gallego
subject: An important message from Mark Kelly and Ruben Gallego
body:
#

| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
| Hey everybody, Mark Kelly here.Mark Kelly
And Ruben Gallego.Ruben Gallego |
| In 2020 and 2022, we shared incredible victories in Arizona.Mark Kelly
And we need your help to win again in 2024.Ruben Gallego |
| I need Ruben with me in the Senate. There's no denying that. But we also have to send a message that candidates like Kari Lake have no place there.Mark Kelly
That's right. We were both at the Capitol on January 6th, and Kari Lake still spreads the lies and conspiracies that led to that terrible day in the first place.Ruben Gallego |
| Exactly — and we both put on our country's uniform to serve. We both swore an oath to defend the Constitution. Mark Kelly
We took that oath seriously.Ruben Gallego |
| To defend our democracy and continue delivering for the people of Arizona, we've got to elect Ruben to the U.S. Senate this year. But he can't do that alone.Mark Kelly
Millions of dollars in attack ads are pouring into Arizona as we speak, and we need to raise a ton of resources to fight back.Ruben Gallego |
| That's why we're coming to you today. To ask for help.Mark Kelly
Because I've got an official FEC deadline coming up on June 30th, and we're behind on our goals.Ruben Gallego |
| [Can you please use this link to make a $5 contribution to Ruben's campaign for U.S. Senate? Do it before that FEC deadline, because afterwards he's legally required to report his fundraising numbers. Everybody will be watching to see how Ruben does. ](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240629-2-120&t=1&akid=2551%2E734936%2EVvKggn)Mark Kelly
Even just a few bucks ads up fast when a ton of people chip in together. Ruben Gallego |
| But not everyone can donate.Mark Kelly
That's why it's so important that you do, if you can. Ruben Gallego | [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240629-2-120&t=2&akid=2551%2E734936%2EVvKggn)
* * *
Thanks for your help — really. It means a lot. – Mark Kelly & Ruben Gallego –

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Header.png]
High Low Ha
My family has a tradition of sharing our “high, low, and ha” of the day: the best, worst, and funniest parts of our time together. Here are mine for the week:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/FamilyLorinser.jpg]
https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Howdy, Friends.
On Sunday, a considerable portion of the Lorinser family will be at the Boyne City Tap Room for the area's largest political fundraiser [https://www.facebook.com/drboblorinser/posts/pfbid02R2TyZeb7sjKjijwCw4HVsaXL16m4Z3AHuWRQ2ArBVQLEhLmYkzuL4nd8Se8SMKz4l] of the year. We're joined by Team Slotkin for Senate and Jodi Decker for State House. If you're around, come out and meet my children and grandchildren.
Learn why this fight is so personal to me — it's about our freedoms, families, and futures.
Last week's High:
Peggy and I hosted five canvassers for a week, knocking on nearly a thousand doors daily. My "high" was treating them to a BBQ and then sitting by the backyard fire, reviewing the positive reports from the field and the voters' stories. It's so encouraging to hear the ratio of voters in our corner.
I 'm truly honored and blessed to have this kind of support.
Low:
The countdown timer above is bugging me! As you know, I am a very outspoken proponent of campaign finance reform. But, with 40 days until the election, we can't afford to slow down. Because we don't rely on big money or corporate PACs, grassroots fundraising before our quarterly FEC deadline is crucial.
I'm beyond grateful for the support we've received. It means the world to me, and we must maintain the pace.
Ha:
The funniest moment was at the Beacon House fundraiser with Steve Mariucci and Tom Izzo. It was a Western theme, and seeing me in cowboy boots and a hat was rare. We had a blast and shared many laughs.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Cowbow.png]
Let's go win an election.
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

clean_body: [] High Low Ha My family has a tradition of sharing our “high, low, and ha” of the day: the best, worst, and funniest parts of our time together. Here are mine for the week: [] [] [] CONTRIBUTE [] Howdy, Friends. On Sunday, a considerable portion of the Lorinser family will be at the Boyne City Tap Room for the area's largest political fundraiser [] of the year. We're joined by Team Slotkin for Senate and Jodi Decker for State House. If you're around, come out and meet my children and grandchildren. Learn why this fight is so personal to me — it's about our freedoms, families, and futures. Last week's High: Peggy and I hosted five canvassers for a week, knocking on nearly a thousand doors daily. My "high" was treating them to a BBQ and then sitting by the backyard fire, reviewing the positive reports from the field and the voters' stories. It's so encouraging to hear the ratio of voters in our corner. I 'm truly honored and blessed to have this kind of support. Low: The countdown timer above is bugging me! As you know, I am a very outspoken proponent of campaign finance reform. But, with 40 days until the election, we can't afford to slow down. Because we don't rely on big money or corporate PACs, grassroots fundraising before our quarterly FEC deadline is crucial. I'm beyond grateful for the support we've received. It means the world to me, and we must maintain the pace. Ha: The funniest moment was at the Beacon House fundraiser with Steve Mariucci and Tom Izzo. It was a Western theme, and seeing me in cowboy boots and a hat was rare. We had a blast and shared many laughs. [] Let's go win an election. -Bob Bob Lorinser Candidate for Congress Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula Democrat, MI01 JOIN OUR FIGHT [] [] Or, send a check to Friends of Dr. Bob PO BOX 936 Marquette, MI 49855 United States Paid for by Friends of Dr. Bob

State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

I have a simple question.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3420%2E552475%2EKHv4YC)
$5, Peter.
That’s what I’m asking you to contribute to my re-election campaign to defend Pennsylvania’s critical seat and stop the GOP from taking the Senate.
$5 might not seem like much, but when everyone chips in, we can build a winning campaign in a critical Senate battleground.
$5 today is what we need to go up against our mega-millionaire Republican opponent and a dark money GOP PAC supporting him that has already amassed a record-breaking amount — over $18 million — to spend against us.
[**We need a lot of supporters chipping in to fight back. Please, Peter, will you donate $5 right now? I need your help to build the strongest possible defense to keep Pennsylvania blue.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240629-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240629-2&refcode2=3420_552475_KHv4YC&akid=3420%2E552475%2EKHv4YC)
Pennsylvania is going to be key in Democrats’ fight to defend our razor-thin Senate majority and the White House. We need all the support we can get to make that happen.
November will be here before we know it. The $5 donations that we raise now will determine what happens to Pennsylvania — and our Nation — then.
[**Will you give $5 now? We will put your donation to work right away in our fight to keep our Commonwealth blue.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240629-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240629-2&refcode2=3420_552475_KHv4YC&akid=3420%2E552475%2EKHv4YC)

clean_body: Let’s show the strength of our grassroots ceasefire movement. | | | Friend, This week, we saw my Squad brother, Jamaal Bowman, lose his congressional primary after being outspent 7 to 1. We cannot allow anti-Palestinian group AIPAC, whose right-wing billionaire donors spent nearly $20 million to unseat Jamaal, defeat any more lawmakers who recognize that Palestinians are human beings Too many of my colleagues in Congress are dehumanizing Palestinians and trying to erase Palestinians from existence. This week, 62 Democrats joined House Republicans to pass legislation to prohibit U.S. officials from even citing the Palestinian death toll. This is genocide denial. That’s why I need your support, as the only Palestinian American currently serving in Congress. Tomorrow represents a critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, after which we’ll report to the Federal Election Commission how much we’ve raised and spent, and how much cash-on-hand we’ll have for the fight ahead. Our opponents and the media will comb through that report, looking for a weakness. But, with your support, they’ll instead see the strength of our grassroots movement for a ceasefire and for Palestinians’ human rights. | I am a daily reminder to my colleagues that the Palestinian people exist, that we are human, and that we are allowed to dream. But still, Republicans and Democrats alike continue to vote to send bombs and ammunition to Israel’s genocidal Prime Minister, who is more interested in maintaining power than bringing an end to this genocide. There is so much anti-Palestinian racism in Congress that it endangers our communities across the U.S. as well. That’s why I need your support today, to continue to speak truth to power and remind members of Congress and the White House of the humanity of all people, with no exceptions. subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:

Hillsdale College

Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey
on the United States Supreme Court is requested.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWrZRQmWTN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your National
Survey on the United States Supreme Court using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63340823:WrZRQmWTN:m:3:2627245898:A502471EAF714DFD5153C1CB23419092:r

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
